original.statement: The status.artifact.digest field is now required in OCIRepository v1; objects omitting it are rejected.

corrected.statement: The source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 OCIRepository schema now requires status.artifact.digest. OCIRepository objects that have status.artifact set but omit status.artifact.digest are exposed to schema rejection.

decision.reason: The computed diff between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] makes `status.artifact.digest` newly required in the OCIRepository v1 schema, and the change text says objects that omit it are rejected. In an OpenAPI schema, a nested required field is only checked when its parent object (`status.artifact`) is present. The proposed condition only checks that the digest is unset, so it also flags every OCIRepository with no `status.artifact`, including every manifest kept in Git, which never carries status. The exposure has to require `status.artifact` to be set and `status.artifact.digest` to be unset on the same object.
